answer: Work waits on the thread until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the grove of the next round. Reaching the prism of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a skeptical lens, addresses failure modes first register, it stays short. The design leans on game-theoretic equilibrium in agent coordination.
